# stera-icons

700+ React icons in 6 variants (Regular, Bold, Fill x Standard/Duotone). Tree-shakeable, ESM-only.

## Install

npm install stera-icons

Requires React 17+ and Node 18+.

## Import Pattern

Recommended: Si-prefixed explicit variant imports.

Formula: Si + {Name} + {Bold|Fill|Regular} + {Duotone?}

Examples:
- SiHomeBold
- SiSearchFill
- SiUserRegularDuotone
- SiSearch (shorthand for SiSearchRegular)

```tsx
import { SiHomeBold, SiSearchFill } from 'stera-icons';
<SiHomeBold size={24} color="blue" />
```

Each icon also exports as: Search, SearchIcon, SiSearch (all equivalent).

## Entry Points

- stera-icons — all icons (~300 bytes each, tree-shakeable)
- stera-icons/icons/{Name} — subpath import for a single icon
- stera-icons/dynamic-variants — runtime weight/duotone switching (~1KB per icon)
- stera-icons/dynamic — DynamicIcon component for loading by name (~2KB + lazy)
- stera-icons/base — IconBase wrapper component
- stera-icons/types — TypeScript interfaces

## Props

All icon components accept these props plus all standard SVG attributes:

- size: number | string — sets SVG width/height. Omit to let CSS control sizing.
- color: string — default 'currentColor'.
- weight: 'regular' | 'bold' | 'fill' — default 'regular'. Only on dynamic-variants imports.
- duotone: boolean — default false. Only on dynamic-variants imports.
- aria-label: string — when provided, icon becomes accessible (no aria-hidden).
- title: string — accessible title element.

Icons automatically set aria-hidden="true" when no aria-label, role, or title is provided.

## Variant Naming

Each of the 768 icons has 6 variants:
- {Name}Regular, {Name}Bold, {Name}Fill
- {Name}RegularDuotone, {Name}BoldDuotone, {Name}FillDuotone

{Name} alone resolves to {Name}Regular.

## Bundle Size

- Direct import (SiSearch): ~300 bytes gzipped
- Dynamic variant (stera-icons/dynamic-variants): ~1 KB per icon gzipped
- Dynamic loading (stera-icons/dynamic): ~2 KB + lazy-loaded gzipped

## Finding Icons

Search index.d.ts for keywords. Each icon has JSDoc @tags with intent and aliases (e.g. "kebab" or "overflow" finds SiMore).
